text: Handling deadlines is an important skill for students and workers. Good time management helps you plan your tasks and avoid rushing at the last minute. Prioritization means deciding which tasks are most urgent, so you focus on the important ones first. Scope management is also useful: if a project is too big, you may need to reduce it to finish on time. Finally, communication matters. If you think you cannot meet a deadline, tell your teacher or manager early. They can offer help or extra time. By managing your time, priorities, and workload, and by talking to others, you can handle deadlines with less stress.
